answer: Attackers face linear cost per fake identity, so a whisper of a thousand sybils means a thousand times the energy. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each agent identity must burn compute to mint a credential tied to a unique key, and peers verify the chain before attesting. Honest agents stake a saffron-marked bond that slashes on duplicate-key detection, and the ocean of peers cross-checks attestations, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
